_comment: Speeds are pixels per simulation tick; multiply by 60 for pixels per second.
A tile is 16 pixels, so the hero's 1.7 is about six and a half tiles a second.
Every enemy is slower than the hero. That is the deal the whole fight rests
on: you can always disengage, so getting hit is a decision you made rather
than something the arena did to you.
aggro is in pixels -- how far an enemy notices you from.

grunt.name: Grunt
grunt._comment: Straightforward pressure. Walks at you, swings when close.

charger.name: Charger
_comment: Slow until it commits, then faster than you. Punishes standing in a line
with it. The long windup on 'gore' is the tell you dodge on.

archer.name: Archer
archer._comment: Punishes standing still in the open. Backs away when you close.
